Free case study

Built from a simple frustration

Thousands of companies collect reviews, tickets and calls every day. Almost none of them analyze them properly. Not for lack of will — but for lack of accessible tools.

On the ground, the question is simple: where are we disappointing our customers, and how do we improve?

For a long time, answering that question cost €100,000 per year and required a data team. The result: years of customer feedback sitting in files nobody read.

AI finally makes this answer accessible — without a data scientist, without an enterprise budget, in 48 hours.

That's why custovox.ai exists.
